messages:
Maya R.: Hi folks, question: I just became legal guardian of my niece, effective 2026-03-01. Can I add her to benefits midyear? What do you need and by when?
People Ops: Congrats, Maya. Yes, a custody/guardianship change is a QLE. Please submit docs within 30 days for retroactive effective date to 2026-03-01. Required: court guardianship order, proof of child's identity (birth cert/passport), proof of residency or school enrollment dated within 60 days, and SSN/ITIN (or SSN application receipt if pending). Upload to the Benefits Hub or email benefits@redwood.com.
Maya R.: SSN is pending. Also wondering about daycare FSA eligibility — do I need anything extra to enroll her for dependent care?
People Ops: For Dependent Care FSA, add the dependent during the QLE and complete the dependent care election in the enrollment flow. If you plan to submit daycare claims, you'll need the provider info and receipts later. No extra docs now beyond the QLE packet.
Sam T.: FYI payroll will prorate based on effective date; if docs arrive after 30 days the effective date will be submission date.
Benefits Bot: Link: https://benefits.redwood.com/qle — upload PDFs only. Reminder sent 1hr after initial message.
Maya R.: Uploaded court order and school record. Marking this thread as done unless you need more. Thanks!
People Ops: Received, we'll process within 3 business days and DM you if anything else is required.
